messages:
deploybot: Scheduled change window starts in 10m. Migration job 'users_email_normalize' queued. Use /deploy abort to cancel. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

olivia: I'll kick off preflight checks now — quick smoke and schema diff.

matt: FYI I see some long-running txn on replica, might need a soft quiesce instead of full quiesce.

olivia: thanks, matt. switching to soft-quiesce plan: drain new writes via feature flag, then apply DDL with lock-guard.

maria: how do we toggle drain? still the same feature flag? example command?

olivia: yes, feature flag `ff-write-drain` on rolling targets. command: `curl -XPOST https://ff.internal/toggle -d '{"flag":"ff-write-drain","on":true}'`

matt: started drain now. traffic shifts reported by trafficbot: 92% reads, 8% buffered writes.

sre-oncall: note: if lock waits > 30s, abort plan and fallback to read-only backfill path.

olivia: preflight logs:
```
preflight: schema-diff OK
preflight: backfill estimated rows 1.2M
preflight: expected lock hold < 20s under soft-quiesce
```

maria: tagging release notes: "Soft-quiesce migration: users.email normalization; expected minimal disruption; fallback to async backfill if lock contention"

deploybot: /deploy start migration users_email_normalize --strategy=soft-quiesce --pin-version=20260320a

matt: migration started. applying ALTER TABLE ... USING expression with concurrent guard.

sre-oncall: seeing a 12s lock on users idx_email_unique, still within tolerance. watching.

matt: entering backfill phase for 0.9M rows, batching 5k, ETA ~22m.

olivia: rolling monitoring dashboard link: https://grafana.internal/d/abcd/migration?from=now-30m — watching commit duration and replica lag.

sre-oncall: replica lag stable. no alerts. :thumbsup:

matt: noticed one worker retried due to deadlock, retried successfully. logs: `deadlock detected, retrying batch 122`

maria: updating customers slack channel with short note: "Migration in soft-quiesce, no customer-facing downtime expected."

deploybot: migration complete. Post-migration checks: index health OK, row-count diff < 0.01%.

olivia: rolling `ff-write-drain` back to false to resume writes.
matt: postflight: vacuum analyze run and cleanup jobs scheduled.
sre-oncall: all good. closing change window. Thanks team. :party_parrot:
